user.title: Sign in to Proton
user.description: Sign in with your Proton account. Your password is only used to sign in and unlock your encryption keys; it is never stored.

human_verification.title: Human verification
human_verification.description:
Proton wants to verify that you are human before allowing this sign-in.

1. Open [the Proton verification page]({url}) and solve the CAPTCHA.
2. Wait until the page confirms the verification.
3. Come back here and select **Submit**.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).

mailbox_password.title: Mailbox password
mailbox_password.description: Your account uses a separate mailbox password (two-password mode). Enter it to unlock your encrypted calendars.

calendars.title: Choose calendars
calendars.description: Select the Proton calendars to add to Home Assistant. Each one becomes a calendar entity you can use in automations.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Proton again
reauth_confirm.description: The Proton session for {username} has expired or was revoked. Enter your password to sign in again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Proton. Try again later.
error.invalid_2fa: The two-factor code was not accepted.
error.invalid_mailbox_password: This password does not unlock your account keys.
error.fido2_only: Your account only has a security key as second factor. Add an authenticator app (TOTP) in your Proton security settings to use this integration.
error.hv_failed: Proton did not accept the verification, so a new CAPTCHA was requested. Open the link again, solve it, and select Submit only after the page confirms.

abort.already_configured: This Proton account is already configured.
abort.no_calendars_found: No calendars were found in this Proton account.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Proton account than the one being re-authenticated.

data_description.lookahead_days: Events in this period are kept in memory for fast state updates and triggers. The calendar panel can still browse further ahead.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Proton is checked for changes.
data_description.filters: Only events whose title or description contains one of these texts (case-insensitive) are passed to Home Assistant. Leave empty to pass all events of the selected calendars.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Home Assistant's Calendar panel is shared by all calendars and users. Turning this off hides it for everyone; your calendar entities keep working.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not load your calendars from Proton. Try again later.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Fix the problem shown on the integration first (for example, sign in again), then try again.
